==Usage==
To use this template, paste <code><nowiki>{{UserFirefox}}</nowiki></code> into your user page. For alternate versions, use <code><nowiki>{{UserFirefox|4}}</nowiki></code> or <code><nowiki>{{UserFirefox|5}}</nowiki></code>.
